mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide causes hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia which increases risk of haloperidol-induced QT prolongation and arrhythmias; both drugs have additive orthostatic hypotension and CNS depression effects.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, maintain potassium and magnesium levels within normal range, monitor ECG if baseline QT prolongation exists, and counsel patient on orthostatic precautions.
